fields.description: Portside Square brings apartments and duplex penthouses to Mina Rashid’s waterfront. Three residential buildings share a leisure pavilion, while the broader development also includes a business tower. Curved balconies, separate study layouts and varied outdoor areas give buyers several distinct home types to compare.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas
